# Studio1 Design System

> Brand fonts, colors, tokens and templates for Studio1 (studio1hq.com), a technical content and DevRel agency for developer-tool companies. Typography is Studio1 Sans (Inter renamed for Studio1), 400/500 only, with -0.03em letter spacing. Code uses the system monospace font. The palette is monochrome with one sky-blue accent.

## Core
- [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md): the full rules for type, color, spacing, components, logo, per-format recipes and don'ts
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): short checklist for AI agents
- [tokens/tokens.json](tokens/tokens.json): all values in W3C Design Tokens format

## Implementation
- [css/studio1.css](css/studio1.css): one import with fonts, tokens, base type and components
- [css/tokens.css](css/tokens.css): `--s1-*` CSS variables, with light and dark modes
- [css/fonts.css](css/fonts.css): self-hosted @font-face rules
- [tailwind/preset.cjs](tailwind/preset.cjs): Tailwind v3 preset
- [tailwind/theme.css](tailwind/theme.css): Tailwind v4 @theme

## Assets
- [fonts/](fonts/): Studio1 Sans Regular and Medium, WOFF2 for web and TTF for desktop (SIL OFL 1.1)
- [logo/](logo/): full Studio1 logo (mark + wordmark) for dark and light backgrounds, and the mark alone in the brand gradient, black and white (SVG)
- [templates/og-image.html](templates/og-image.html): 1200×630 featured image
- [templates/code-snippet.html](templates/code-snippet.html): code snippet card
